info.name: Get Affected Libraries for a Zero-Day Event

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of items to be returned in the response.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Parameter indicates the starting point for retrieving results, the first call doesn't include a cursor parameter in the request, the API response includes the first set of results along with a cursor pointing to the last item retrieved.

params.name: orgUuid
params.description: org UUID (from the Mend App: **Administration** General > **Organization UUID**).

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of publicly known affected packages (CVEs and their associated components) for a specific Zero-Day Event.

**Note:** This endpoint returns ecosystem-wide affected package data sourced from public vulnerability databases — it does not reflect findings from your organization's inventory or installed libraries.
